milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the green banner at spawn-relative (4, 0, 5) and face toward it. Max distance reduced to 5 blocks to ensure the player actually walks toward it (spawn distance is ~6.4 blocks, so player must move closer). Facing tolerance of 60° ensures the player is looking at the banner.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the dark oak button at spawn-relative (7, 1, 5) on the west face of the stone brick wall and face toward it. Max distance of 5 blocks ensures the player has walked to the wall area (spawn distance is ~8.6 blocks). Facing tolerance of 60° ensures the player is looking at the button.

Uses inventory_has because mining magma_block with a pickaxe drops the magma_block item into the player's inventory. The player must mine at least 1 magma block from the deposit at spawn-relative ~10-13, 0, 3-7. A diamond pickaxe is provided in the scene. This is the most direct and reliable check for a mine task.

Uses position_inside_box because the bridge task is fundamentally a navigation/traversal task — the player must physically cross the 7-block-wide lava gap (x=14 to x=20) by placing blocks. The detection box at spawn-relative x=19-25, y=-1 to 3, z=1-9 covers the far platform and can only be reached by successfully bridging across. This is a movement task where reaching the destination proves completion.
